property_summary: Whenever a call to play() succeeds (i.e. the exact ticket price was paid), the pot is afterwards always either 0 (player won) or exactly TICKET_AMOUNT (player lost); the mutant's extra pot += TICKET_AMOUNT leaves pot at 2*TICKET_AMOUNT after a loss, violating the rule.
change_summary: Insert an extra `pot += TICKET_AMOUNT;` at the start of the function body so pot grows by twice the ticket amount.
